summary: Task 4 (Material Master & UOM Controls) backend tested end-to-end. 54/54 pytest tests PASS on clean DB against the public preview URL. Covered: (a) UOM Units CRUD + RBAC + case-insensitive dup + delete-in-use guard, (b) UOM Conversions CRUD + validation (dup, unregistered unit, factor<=0, from==to), (c) /uom/convert direct/reverse/2-hop chain/no-path, (d) Category tree CRUD + slash-in-name, sibling dup case-insensitive, inactive parent block, cycle prevention on PUT, reason-required, delete blocked by children and by referencing material, (e) Materials POST/PUT with category_id + base_uom + category_path persistence + backward-compat legacy POST, (f) CSV templates for all three (text/csv with correct headers), (g) CSV bulk import summaries for units/conversions/categories, (h) master_audit_logs entries verified for master.unit, uom.conversion and category writes. RBAC negative users (site_engineer/pm/purchase) seeded directly in Mongo per instructions. Anonymous write returns 401 as expected. One MINOR observation on categories CSV import (duplicates undercount) documented below.

minor.issue: When a supplied `path` already exists in full, the row is silently skipped and NOT counted under `summary.duplicates` (dup list only fills when last_cat_id ends up None, which never happens after the first matching iteration). Impact: import summary hides duplicate rows. Fix: after the for-loop, if any name was found existing (i.e., no new insert happened for this row), append to `dup` list. Reference: /app/backend/routers/categories.py:308-341

action_items: MINOR: Update POST /api/categories/import (routers/categories.py) to append to `dup` list when a row's leaf name already exists (instead of only when last_cat_id is None). This will correctly reflect dup counts in the summary.
critical_code_review_comments: uom.py `_resolve_factor` builds an in-memory graph on every /uom/convert call — fine while UOM count is small (documented in the file), but consider caching or an index if it grows.

categories.py `_recompute_paths(None)` scans and rewrites the whole tree on every create/update. Acceptable for a few hundred nodes; document O(N) behavior and consider subtree-only recomputation later.

uom.py `uom_delete_unit` blocks when unit is used in a conversion but does NOT block when the unit is used as `base_uom` on an existing material — consider adding that check symmetric to the category-vs-material delete guard.
categories_import: also `errors` is populated correctly for over-long names but silent no-op on full-path duplicates (see minor issue).
seed_data_creation: Seeded 3 non-admin users (site_engineer, pm, purchase) via seed_rbac_users.py inserting directly into db.users + db.user_sessions (dev-login disabled under ACCESS_SECURITY_V2). Director token from /app/memory/test_credentials.md was still valid and used as-is. During testing the following domain data was created and left in the DB: units (Nos, Metre, Centimetre, Kilogram, Gram, Box, Piece, Litre), conversions (Metre→Centimetre, Box→Nos, Kilogram→Gram, Nos→Piece, Metre→Nos, Litre→Millilitre attempt errored), categories (Fire Alarm, Detectors, Heat, Electrical, Electrical/Wiring), and two TEST_-prefixed materials (MAT-0001, MAT-0002). Note: I wiped task-4 collections once mid-run (masters/unit + uom_conversions + material_categories + materials + master_audit_logs + counters._id=materials) to establish a clean fixture for the final green run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Task 4 endpoints (/api/uom/*, /api/categories/*, POST+PUT /api/materials with category_id/base_uom) are functional. Test file `test_task4_material_uom.py` is order/state dependent (idempotent only from a clean slate); if re-running, first wipe: db.masters.deleteMany({category:'unit'}); db.uom_conversions.deleteMany({}); db.material_categories.deleteMany({}); db.materials.deleteMany({}); db.master_audit_logs.deleteMany({}); db.counters.deleteMany({_id:'materials'}). RBAC seed script is idempotent (upsert). Director token: dev_task4_test_b07ffffb26e3438b (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md).
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking Task 4. One minor cosmetic issue on categories CSV import summary counting is documented under backend_issues.minor with reproduction: POST /api/categories/import with a CSV row whose `path` already fully exists returns summary.duplicates=0 (should be >=1).
